name: MDF board price inquiry
description: Tests price lookup for MDF board. The AI should return the real product name and price from the hds_prices table for MDF.

expected_behaviors.description: Reply should contain a price with R prefix
Reply should reference MDF in the product name

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply

notes: MDF is a distinct product category from melamine. The AI should not confuse MDF with melamine chipboard and should return the correct MDF price from the table.
